4893880.desc: Von Neumann Project is a space based RTS where you build, mine, and expand across the universe in an attempt to find your creator's equals. Play across 4 different sectors with 28 handcrafted missions, with each sector introducing unique enemies, buildings, and missions.

5073350.name: Build the Hole
5073350.desc: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

4905420.name: Rinha de Waifus
4905420.desc: Be the strategist behind cute waifus in a tactical, chaotic auto battler: set your formations, pick each one's playstyle, then watch it go gloriously right! Or wrong?! Solo campaigns and challenges, online 1v1s against friends, a roguelite Arena and a ranked Ladder for the ambitious.
categories: 共享 / 分割螢幕玩家對戰

4857840.name: Crops & Coops
4857840.desc: 獨自經營一座小島農場，或與最多三位好友線上合作。種植作物、釣魚並逐步實現農場自動化，在輕鬆的像素風增量遊戲中持續發展。

5037670.name: We're Gonna Need More Fireballs
5037670.desc: You're gonna need a bigger tower. Then thirty of them. A million bugs are coming down tunnels the size of a city, and the only correct answer is more fire. Burn them, rot them, feed them to hungry trees - whatever you do, don't stop casting.

5352570.name: RailBlaster
5352570.desc: Ride twisting rails through ten worlds that pulse with the music, blasting everything in sight. Build combos, slow time, outsmart ghosts, blinkers and walls, and face two bosses. Play on a monitor or in VR, or with up to 8 players in local split-screen.
categories: 共享 / 分割螢幕玩家對戰

5354590.name: 神话大乱斗
5354590.desc: 《神話大亂鬥》是一款水墨暗黑風格的國風神話卡牌肉鴿遊戲。諸神失序、渾沌亂世，你將化身五大道統傳人，以劍、體、弓、法、符五系一千二百餘張卡牌自由構築牌庫，橫掃妖山、幽冥、佛國、劍冢、天庭五大卷一百二十五名神話怪物；藉助十二星座加點、五十五套套裝共鳴、連鎖連招與卡牌強化打造專屬流派構築，最終殺上凌霄寶殿，終結這場曠世神話大戰！遊戲完整支援簡體中文、繁體中文與英文，內建三檔難度、無盡模式、八十項成就與雲存檔。諸神黃昏，輪到你出牌了！
